name: sattleme-assistant
description: Makes your sattle.me invoices (numbered, with VAT, a PDF and a Bitcoin payment link) and tells whether they were paid.
long_description:
The sattle.me assistant makes your business's invoices with the key you create for it in the sattle.me app (Intégrations › Créer une intégration › Assistant IA): numbered in your one series, with their VAT, a PDF and a payment link your clients pay in bitcoin, until their due date. It tells whether an invoice was paid as soon as the payments prove it.

The key never spends: every invoice pays your own wallet. It stays on this computer. Remove the assistant in the app to stop it at once.

tools.name: business_profile
tools.description: Your business as its invoices print it, today's date and the due dates allowed.

tools.name: preview_invoice
tools.description: Checks an invoice and computes its totals, without making it.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Makes the invoice the user asked for: its number, its payment link.

tools.name: invoice_pdf
tools.description: An invoice as a PDF, with its QR code.

tools.name: invoice_card_pdf
tools.description: The invoice card's own tool: saves an invoice's PDF on your device.

tools.name: export_transactions
tools.description: Your transactions of a period for your accountant, as the app exports them (CSV or PDF), once you allowed it in the app.

assistant_key.title: Assistant key
assistant_key.description: The key the sattle.me app gave when you created the assistant (sattleme_ak_…). Kept in your computer's secret store.

pdf_directory.title: Folder for exports and invoices
pdf_directory.description:
Where the invoices' PDFs and the exports are saved.
Empty: they are only shown in the conversation.
